items: Incredible Sound Loved by 20 Million+ People

items.label: Hi-Res Audio
items.value: Custom oversized 40 mm dynamic drivers produce Hi-Res sound. Life Q20 active noise canceling headphones reproduce music with extended high frequencies that reach up to 40 kHz for extraordinary clarity and detail.

items.label: Reduce Ambient Noises By Up to 90%
items.value: Our team of engineers conducted more than 100,000 tests in real-life scenarios to fine-tune Life Q20’s 4 built-in ANC microphones and digital active noise cancellation algorithm. As a result, the hybrid active noise cancellation can detect and cancel out a wider range of low and mid-frequency noises such as cars and airplane engines.

items.label: 100% Stronger Bass
items.value: Our exclusive BassUp technology conducts real-time analysis of the low frequencies to instantly strengthen the bass output. Double press the play button when listening to bass-heavy genres like EDM and hip-hop for an amplified listening experience.

items.label: 60-Hour Playtime*
items.value: Up to 40 hours of non-stop playtime in wireless active noise cancellation mode (at 60% volume) is extended to an enormous 60 hours in standard music mode. A single charge gives you enough juice to listen to over 900 songs or soundtrack multiple long haul flights. And when you’re in a rush, charge Life Q20 active noise canceling headphones for 5 minutes and get 4 hours of listening.

items.label: What's in the box
items.value: soundcore Life Q20 x1; USB-C Charging Cable x1; AUX Cable x1; Travel Pouch x1.

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: AUX Cable x1, Cable, Travel Pouch x1, soundcore Life Q20 Headphone x1
